title: Us vs Them

script.script:
You really think those nail clippers scare me? 

You better put them down. 

I'll bleed everywhere and I mean everywhere. 

Infection, scarring, pain that'll make you rethink your whole life.

Oh, you're gonna try the freezing kit? 

Go ahead. 

I'll blister up, scab over, and leave a scar worse than me. 

And guess what? 

I'll probably grow right back in the same spot.

You think that string is gonna work? 

Tie me off, watch me turn purple, feel me throb for a week straight. 

And when I finally fall off? 

I'm leaving a mark. 

A permanent little reminder that you tried.

Yeah, put them down. 

That's what I thought. 

I'm not going anywhere.

Wait, what is that? 

Cold-pressed castor oil? 

No, no, no, no. 

You don't need that. 

Just leave me alone.

Why does it smell like that? 

Why is it sinking into my skin?

No. No no no.

We had a deal.

Why am I choking? 

The ricinoleic acid is cutting off my blood supply.

I'm drying out. 

I'm actually drying out.

Somebody help me.

Remove skin tags at home in just a few weeks with Haven & Spool. 

No pain, no bleeding, no scars.

Just roll it on before bed and let it work while you sleep.

Try it risk-free.
